line: Claude Cloud exploratory analysis. Not a Research OS or Science Supervisor ruling, not a formal F50 closure claim.
frozen_law: SB8_G05: k=8 spherical-kmeans sub-bunches per core, own single-well-style dynamics (salt_MF,j + 0.5*attract_gain*nr(pop_attract - m_j)) integrated per engine dt-step; core prediction = count-weighted mean of sub-bunch centroids
pass_criterion: 250-step core-centre rollout skill beats universal AR3 on BOTH prospective tapes
verdict: FAIL on both prospective tapes at all three horizons (5, 50, 250 steps). The autonomous sub-bunch law does not beat AR3; it is substantially worse (roughly an order of magnitude in error) at every horizon tested.
